title: Xray

description.en: A closer look at your Twitter / X activity, with analytics and AI-powered reports.
description.zh: 深入查看 Twitter / X 动态，用数据分析与 AI 报告理解自己的内容。

subject: Original multicolored butterfly with complete spread wings

source.description: Personal Twitter/X analytics dashboard with AI-powered reporting

subject.en: Original multicolored butterfly with complete spread wings
subject.zh: 保留原样的多彩展翅蝴蝶

description.en: The owner-selected butterfly keeps its exact native position, silhouette and colorful wing pattern. Both sides of the comparison use the same foreground.
description.zh: 保留原来蝴蝶的位置、轮廓与多彩翼纹。前后对比使用完全相同的透明主体。

description.en: Coral, gold, turquoise and violet facets remain untouched. This is a presentation pass with zero image-generation requests.
description.zh: 珊瑚、金黄、松石与紫色色面全部保留。本轮只完善展示，没有调用生图模型。

description.en: Unequal, open wing-vein panels meet on a muted plum field. The broad seams and soft contact shadow let the vivid butterfly stay in front.
description.zh: 不等宽的开放翼脉面板铺在柔和梅紫底色上，宽阔接缝与浅接触阴影托起鲜艳的蝴蝶。

palette.source: Selected Xray presentation, 2026-09-07-01/01; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: The original 2048 px foreground and placement are retained exactly. Existing nearest rounded-outline clearance is 124.61 px with no clipped pixels. Fine facets and small sparks simplify at 16 px; app and browser marks use the transparent source.
sizeNote.zh: 原有 2048 px 透明主体与位置保持完全一致，距圆角轮廓最近处为 124.61 px，没有像素被裁掉。细小切面与电光在 16 px 时会简化，小型 UI 与浏览器使用透明主体。

goal.en: Collect X / Twitter and custom-source content into watchlists, then read, translate, and save links from one timeline.
goal.zh: 将 X / Twitter 与自定义来源的内容按关注列表收集，在同一时间线中阅读、翻译和保存链接。

role.zh: 关注列表、内容与设置存储

description.en: Unequal, interlocking wing panels follow the butterfly’s veins without repeating its colored silhouette.
description.zh: 大小不同的翅脉分区相互衔接，沿着蝴蝶的纹理展开，不重复彩色主体。

alt.en: Original multicolored butterfly with complete spread wings on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 保留原样的多彩展翅蝴蝶，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.en: Multicolored butterfly with complete spread wings.

Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥48px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 48px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
